sheet = 'Knot measurements'
rows = data_rows(sheet, {'B': 'number', 'C': 'number'}, start_row=702, end_row=706)
pts = sorted([(num(sheet, f'B{r}'), num(sheet, f'C{r}')) for r in rows])

def interp(x):
    for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
        x0, y0 = pts[i]
        x1, y1 = pts[i+1]
        if x0 <= x <= x1:
            return y0 + (y1 - y0) * (x - x0) / (x1 - x0)
    return pts[0][1] if x == pts[0][0] else pts[-1][1]

# Integrate from 2 to 18 using trapezoidal rule with knot points in between
x_vals = [2.0] + [p[0] for p in pts if 2.0 < p[0] < 18.0] + [18.0]
x_vals = sorted(list(set(x_vals)))

total_area = 0.0
for i in range(len(x_vals) - 1):
    x_a = x_vals[i]
    x_b = x_vals[i+1]
    y_a = interp(x_a)
    y_b = interp(x_b)
    total_area += 0.5 * (y_a + y_b) * (x_b - x_a)

result = round(total_area, 2)
